symptom: Reset truncates a chat's visible transcript but its persisted Claude, Codex or Cursor binding still resumes the discarded provider history after reopening.
rule: Retire the exact chat's execution and detach its durable native binding with the transcript cut; test restart, Undo, late results and mixed-version replay ownership. See agents/zstack/playbooks/bug-fix.md and agents/zstack/changes/conversation-context-reset.md.
